data.subTitle: MERN stack magician, Web3 enthusiast, and part-time debugger. Passionate about building responsive web applications and exploring modern technologies.
aboutDescription: Hello! I'm Sindhu Harini, a passionate full-stack web developer with a strong interest in modern web technologies.
I enjoy creating responsive and user-friendly web applications using React.js, JavaScript, Node.js, MongoDB, and Java.
My journey into programming started with curiosity and has grown into a passion for building real-world projects and continuously improving my technical skills.
I love exploring both frontend and backend technologies while developing projects that solve practical problems.
Alongside development, I am constantly learning new tools and technologies to strengthen my expertise in full-stack development and Web3.
If you're interested in my work, explore my portfolio below, and let's connect for collaboration opportunities!

projects.description: A Learning Management System designed for offline learning institutes to manage student enrollment, course tracking, instructor interaction, and educational resources efficiently.
A cafe management system built to streamline online ordering using QR-based table management, kitchen ticket handling, customer management, and order tracking.
A desktop-based inventory management system developed using Java, Swing, and JDBC to efficiently manage stock, product details, and inventory operations.

data.contactParagraph: I'm currently open to work and collaborate on exciting projects, so feel free to get in touch if you'd like to hire me or work together.
